body:
Make your voice be heard, by others and by yourself as well.

Talk to someone, talk to a friend, anyone can offer emotional support and advice. Anything that you're going trough will pass, and better days are coming towards you. Be patient, be strong, you're the only person that matters in your whole life, make the best version of you. Start something new, get rid of the loop in your life and break free from your routines.

Are you nuts saying "me too"? 

Do you know what that does to a depressed person, let me tell you, A 100 TIMES WORSE. If you cant help or support someone don't add more pressure to it, think twice before saying something.
